verdict.rationale: Shortcut publishes a first-party MCP server under its own GitHub org (useshortcut/mcp-server-shortcut). Its docs include setup guides for connecting agents such as Codex CLI and Claude Code through that server, and its marketing promotes connecting agents like Cursor and Claude Code. missing for 10: documentation of the exposed MCP tools/capabilities and auth model, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
You can add a new MCP server from the Claude Code CLI.
Connect Shortcut to tools like Cursor and Claude Code to get agents coding and synced to GitHub.
